description: Merges up to six bus chains into one, adding the blue, orange and red stereo buses of each to the same bus on the others

params.text: Switches that bus chain into the merge or out of it over a 26ms fade; a press held for 0.7 seconds auditions that chain and mutes the other five

inputs.text: Takes a bus chain from another module's BUS OUT; its three stereo buses are added to those of the other five inputs and sent to BUS OUT

outputs.text: Carries the merged bus chain as six channels on one polyphonic cable, blue then orange then red, left before right

notes: nothing happens until another Glue the Giant module's BUS OUT is patched into one of the BUS IN jacks, and BUS OUT has to reach a Bus Depot before the merged chain is heard
holding one of the six buttons for 0.7 seconds auditions that chain and mutes the other five; holding a second adds it. A single click ends the audition, which reaches no other module
